captions.zh: 场景 1/6 · 网络正常：网管每轮探测全部 36 个目标，没有告警。
captions.en: Scene 1/6 · Normal network: the EMS probes all 36 targets every round; no alarm.

captions.zh: 场景 2/6 · L1 性能劣化：网络正常，下一轮注入故障。
captions.en: Scene 2/6 · Degradation of L1: healthy; a fault is injected next.

captions.zh: 已注入：L1 单向时延增加 20 ms。16 / 36 个目标越过阈值；判决器持续观察，智能体研判并复核。
captions.en: Injected: 20 ms of extra one-way delay on L1. 16 of 36 targets cross their thresholds; the detector keeps watching, the agent diagnoses and re-checks.

captions.zh: 16 / 36 个目标越过阈值，却都说不出故障在哪；EdgeFDL 只发 1 条告警：L1 时延劣化（注入后 35 秒）。
captions.en: 16 of 36 targets cross their thresholds and none says where the fault is; EdgeFDL raises 1 alarm: L1 delay degradation, 35 s after the injection.

captions.zh: 故障已修复，系统按告警自身的证据确认恢复。
captions.en: Fault repaired; the system confirms recovery on the alarm's own evidence.

captions.zh: 告警已恢复：修复后 15 秒。
captions.en: Alarm cleared 15 s after the repair.

captions.zh: 场景 3/6 · 链路中断与备份路径接管：网络正常，下一轮注入故障。
captions.en: Scene 3/6 · Link down, backup path takes over: healthy; a fault is injected next.

captions.zh: 已注入：L6 中断。7 / 36 个目标越过阈值；判决器持续观察，智能体研判并复核。
captions.en: Injected: L6 down. 7 of 36 targets cross their thresholds; the detector keeps watching, the agent diagnoses and re-checks.

captions.zh: L6 链路中断（注入后 30 秒）。7 个目标已改走备份路径（L13.h3：ems>core>agg2>acc3>h3 → ems>core>agg2>acc4>acc3>h3）；等价网络预演：备份接管可行。
captions.en: L6 link down, 30 s after the injection. 7 targets moved to the backup path (L13.h3: ems>core>agg2>acc3>h3 to ems>core>agg2>acc4>acc3>h3); rehearsal on the equivalent network: takeover feasible.

captions.zh: 故障已修复，系统按告警自身的证据确认恢复。
captions.en: Fault repaired; the system confirms recovery on the alarm's own evidence.

captions.zh: 告警已恢复：修复后 15 秒。
captions.en: Alarm cleared 15 s after the repair.

captions.zh: 场景 4/6 · 路由漂移：网络正常，下一轮注入故障。
captions.en: Scene 4/6 · Route drift: healthy; a fault is injected next.

captions.zh: 已注入：L4 的 OSPF 开销变为 10 倍。5 / 36 个目标越过阈值；判决器持续观察，智能体研判并复核。
captions.en: Injected: the OSPF cost of L4 multiplied by 10. 5 of 36 targets cross their thresholds; the detector keeps watching, the agent diagnoses and re-checks.

captions.zh: L4 路由漂移（注入后 30 秒）：L4 的 OSPF 开销 10 → 100。全部目标仍可达，5 个目标换了路径（L11.h1：ems>core>agg1>acc1>h1 → ems>core>agg1>acc2>acc1>h1）。
captions.en: L4 route drift, 30 s after the injection: the OSPF cost of L4 went from 10 to 100. All targets stay reachable; 5 take a new path (L11.h1: ems>core>agg1>acc1>h1 to ems>core>agg1>acc2>acc1>h1).

captions.zh: 故障已修复，系统按告警自身的证据确认恢复。
captions.en: Fault repaired; the system confirms recovery on the alarm's own evidence.

captions.zh: 告警已恢复：修复后 15 秒。
captions.en: Alarm cleared 15 s after the repair.

captions.zh: 场景 5/6 · 两处故障同时发生：网络正常，下一轮注入故障。
captions.en: Scene 5/6 · Two simultaneous faults: healthy; a fault is injected next.

captions.zh: 已注入：L5 单向时延增加 20 ms；L7 丢包 15%。10 / 36 个目标越过阈值；判决器持续观察，智能体研判并复核。
captions.en: Injected: 20 ms of extra one-way delay on L5; 15% loss on L7. 10 of 36 targets cross their thresholds; the detector keeps watching, the agent diagnoses and re-checks.

captions.zh: 第一条告警：L7 丢包劣化（注入后 45 秒）。系统扣除它的效应，继续研判残差。
captions.en: First alarm: L7 loss degradation, 45 s after the injection. The system subtracts its effect and keeps diagnosing the residual.

captions.zh: 第二条告警：L5 时延劣化（注入后 85 秒）。两处故障，两条告警，各有证据和处置建议。
captions.en: Second alarm: L5 delay degradation, 85 s after the injection. Two faults, two alarms, each with its own evidence and advice.

captions.zh: 只修复 L7，等它的告警按自身证据恢复。
captions.en: Only L7 is repaired; its alarm has to clear on its own evidence.

captions.zh: L7 丢包劣化 的告警已恢复，L5 时延劣化 的告警继续保持。
captions.en: The alarm L7 loss degradation has cleared; L5 delay degradation stays active.

captions.zh: 故障已修复，系统按告警自身的证据确认恢复。
captions.en: Fault repaired; the system confirms recovery on the alarm's own evidence.

captions.zh: 告警已恢复：修复后 15 秒。
captions.en: Alarm cleared 15 s after the repair.

captions.zh: 只持续一轮的瞬时干扰：36 / 36 个目标越过阈值，判决器不触发，没有告警。
captions.en: A one-round transient: 36 of 36 targets cross their thresholds; the detector does not trigger and no alarm is raised.

captions.zh: 告警已恢复：修复后 15 秒。
captions.en: Alarm cleared 15 s after the repair.

captions.zh: 场景 6/6 · 设备宕机：网络正常，下一轮注入故障。
captions.en: Scene 6/6 · A device goes down: healthy; a fault is injected next.

captions.zh: 已注入：设备 acc3 宕机（L6、L9、L10、L13 全部中断）。9 / 36 个目标越过阈值；判决器持续观察，智能体研判并复核。
captions.en: Injected: device acc3 down (L6, L9, L10, L13 all down). 9 of 36 targets cross their thresholds; the detector keeps watching, the agent diagnoses and re-checks.

captions.zh: acc3 的 4 条链路全部中断，告警只有 1 条：设备 acc3 宕机（注入后 30 秒），覆盖这 4 条链路。
captions.en: All 4 links of acc3 are down and there is 1 alarm: device acc3 down, 30 s after the injection, covering the 4 links.

captions.zh: 故障已修复，系统按告警自身的证据确认恢复。
captions.en: Fault repaired; the system confirms recovery on the alarm's own evidence.

captions.zh: 告警已恢复：修复后 15 秒。
captions.en: Alarm cleared 15 s after the repair.
